Market today: The market mood is dominated by bond yield uncertainty. Conflicting views on whether yields will keep rising or if the Treasury could intervene (headlines 1, 6, 8) are the real drivers, directly impacting your tech/chip names by influencing future earnings valuations.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.61%) and SPAL (-42.39%) are leveraged, decaying, and showing massive losses. Your stops are far from current prices. Given you're on margin, these drawdowns are amplified and need immediate attention. SMH (-11.94%) and QQQI (-3.85%) are also on TRIM status and nearing their stops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements and any developments from the Treasury regarding potential bond buybacks. Also, monitor geopolitical tensions with Iran (headline 10) for broader market risk.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, deeply underwater positions and stay vigilant on bond yield trends.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL stops: Your current stops are far from market prices for these leveraged, decaying ETFs. Adjust them to realistic levels to manage significant downside risk.
Monitor SMH and QQQI: Both are on TRIM status and close to their stops (SMH at 540, QQQI at 52). Be prepared to act if these levels are breached.
